title: Aureline M5 ownership signal
description: Canonical per-domain descriptor for an ownership signal. Names the object class, its review-pack association, the owned scope slice, the advisory-versus-enforced owner authority, and the owner approval state so an advisory owner is never flattened into an enforced-owner merge gate. Downstream review detail, the ownership overlay, merge-readiness, and support / export packets point at this schema instead of restating ownership by hand. Raw paths, secret values, and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
